visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are seated on a light-colored sofa in a brightly lit studio environment. The woman on the left has short brown hair and wears a green tank top with 'PEARL' printed on it. The middle woman has long black hair and a vibrant pink tank top. The woman on the right has long brown hair and wears a white sheer top over a blue shirt. A white bookshelf filled with books and small plants stands behind them against a soft pink wall. (2) A visual game interface appears in the upper center of the frame, showing a zoomed-in square photo of a person's lips. The women react with explosive energy, throwing their hands into the air and opening their mouths in surprise. A full portrait of a K-pop idol soon replaces the close-up feature. Large white and green text overlays appear frequently at the bottom and sides to reflect their dialogue. (3) The sequence continues with new rounds showing different facial features like a nose, an eye, and teeth. The women maintain high physical activity, pointing at the screen, leaning forward in anticipation, and laughing. The lighting is consistent and bright, illuminating their expressive facial movements and hand gestures as they compete to shout out the correct names. (4) Between the game rounds, the women are shown interacting with each other, sometimes touching their hair or adjusting their seating positions. They smile broadly and look towards one another while talking. The camera remains at a static eye-level perspective throughout the entire video, focusing on the trio's reactions and the evolving game graphics appearing above their heads.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM starts with a driving four-on-the-floor beat and bright synthesizer pads. Three female voices enter simultaneously, speaking with extremely high pitch variability and rapid speech rates, creating a sense of chaotic excitement. The acoustics are clean and centered. (2) A sharp, high-pitched 'ding' sound effect cuts through the mix, followed immediately by loud, high-arousal screaming and laughter from the women. Their voices reach peak intensity as they celebrate a correct guess. The BGM maintains its steady rhythmic pulse underneath the vocal outbursts. (3) The audio shifts into a dense dialogue phase where the three voices overlap frequently, discussing game rules and clues. The speech is highly enunciated but fast-paced. Occasional 'whoosh' transitions and 'pop' bubble SFX accompany visual changes, while the background music remains a constant, energetic presence. (4) Another round of guessing triggers a series of rapid vocal reactions. The women's voices exhibit rising intonations as they pose questions and falling intonations as they confirm answers. The overall audio design is hyper-dense, with sound effects, music, and voices layered tightly to create a social-media-native sensory experience.
